name: scheduled-chat-continuation-gate
principle: The hourly :00 and :30 paper workers are the same task. At run start, read the latest durable candidate_inventory: candidate_inventory >= 50 selects Discovery; candidate_inventory < 50 selects Research/Audit. After that selection both schedules use the same mode procedure, persistence rules, continuation gate, and finalization gate. Existing mode quotas remain floors, not stop ceilings.

always_on_policy.rule: Both hourly paper workers use the same threshold router. Schedule time never selects a different paper workflow. candidate_inventory >= 50 means Discovery; candidate_inventory < 50 means Research/Audit.

scheduled_handoff_policy.rule: Both hourly paper-worker compatibility kinds use the same run-local handoff policy: capture actual invocation start once, define run_deadline = actual_start + run_window_seconds, and before starting any independent work unit pass the remaining time to continuation_gate.py. Within handoff_guard_seconds start no new unit; within hard_finalize_seconds perform only durable finalization. The compatibility worker_kind label must not change Research/Audit or Discovery execution semantics.

research_blocked_retry_policy.rule: Each distinct research blocked event is counted once by GitHub Actions. Attempts 1 and 2 remain blocked for a one-hour cooldown and are then returned to ready without losing block history. The third blocked event is promoted to blocked_permanent and is not automatically retried. Repeated survey-helper runs must not double-count the same blocked event.

fallback_policy.rule: GitHub is the canonical direct transport. If GitHub write is unavailable, ChatGPT Library is the only external durable outbox. On recovery, Library submits immutable envelopes to GitHub fallback-inbox. Research/audit record bundles are converted by replay_record_fallback.py into safe record-bank slots plus attempt-specific immutable descriptors; non-record envelopes use the generic allowlisted fallback transport. Historical chat-inbox bundles are read compatibility only and are never recreated.

backlog_policy.rule: Record-bank count, Library pending count, GitHub fallback-inbox count, and unsent-paper count are transport-state metrics, not research-capacity limits. Normal research/audit workers use the bank reserved by the claim result; the selector is diagnostic/maintenance/fallback-replay support.

probe_success.action: checkpoint only the affected complete logical payload through ChatGPT Library fallback when direct GitHub write still cannot preserve it, leave its GitHub job incomplete, continue independent work, and allow later unrelated GitHub writes

probe_failure.action: disable further GitHub writes for the remainder of this run; checkpoint each completed payload through ChatGPT Library; when normal GitHub ready work is exhausted, continue from fallback spillover candidates or create an offline job seed and keep researching

fallback_failure_protocol.chatgpt_library_failed: if GitHub direct write can still durably preserve required state, continue through GitHub; otherwise STOP_RUN before producing an uncheckpointed completed result or undispatchable offline seed
fallback_failure_protocol.source_recovery_failed: leave the Library source pending and continue other research or GitHub-direct work; never treat one replay failure as a global stop
fallback_failure_protocol.dependency_not_materialized: leave the valid research/audit envelope in GitHub fallback-inbox until its deterministic canonical job is materialized; do not quarantine it merely for arriving before the offline seed
fallback_failure_protocol.duplicate_intake: if the same envelope id and content already exists in GitHub fallback-inbox/archive, acknowledge the Library copy without re-dispatching it
fallback_failure_protocol.id_conflict: quarantine only the conflicting envelope; do not overwrite the GitHub ledger and do not stop unrelated work

end_of_run_gate.rule: Before emitting a final response, apply the run-local handoff policy and continuation_gate.py. The :00 and :30 schedules are identical paper workers. Determine mode only from the latest durable candidate_inventory: >=50 is Discovery, <50 is Research/Audit. In Research/Audit mode, fewer than 3 durably added new papers cannot establish voluntary completion unless a hard stop applies. In Discovery mode, fewer than 4 materially distinct durable rounds cannot establish discovery exhaustion unless a hard stop applies. Quotas are floors, not ceilings. A single empty or duplicate-only Discovery round, one completed paper, or schedule identity is not a stop reason.

worker_instruction_policy.only_task_difference: none; both schedules use candidate_inventory threshold routing

discovery_route_policy.rule: Normal Discovery prioritizes the citation graph in both directions. Process at least one backward-reference window and one forward-citation window for the same run_key before normal/new keyword search. A non-empty structured-reference pool does not block forward-citation refresh. After both directions are attempted, continue with the citation direction/seed that has the best recent yield; use normal search only to fill gaps.

research_quota_policy.counting_rule: Count only new papers durably reflected on latest main after full-text reading, five-slot record completion, preflight, and immutable submission. Claims, checkpoints, status-only outcomes, audits, discovery candidates, and pending submissions do not count.

discovery_progression.rule: When the threshold router selects Discovery, one durable discovery submission is an intermediate checkpoint. Unless a hard stop or the run-local handoff guard is active, complete at least four materially distinct Discovery rounds before discovery-space exhaustion may be used as a voluntary stop reason. Four rounds is a floor, not a ceiling.
